p: Jones will keep his return duties despite two ball-security mistakes.
Harbaugh backs him, but he has had a muffed punt and a kickoff-return fumble, which puts his return role at some risk.
I have complete confidence in Charlie.
Jones' availability and effectiveness depend on how his thumb responds to catching.
His thumb is a live concern, so check the final injury report and inactives before using him or relying on his return duties.
Harbaugh praised his deep catch during the comeback push, but it is a single-play compliment, not a role change.
That was awesome. I thought it was a great play.
